Title: Name changes: Azure SQL Database long-term backup retention, US Government regions

Body.Content:
Effective June 1, 2018, long-term backup retention names will change from “LTR RA-GRS Backup Storage” to “LTR Backup Storage.” There won’t be a pricing impact, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on names.

See the following table for name changes.
